title: Remaining hours per backlog and a partial solution total
goal: The owner sees how much estimated work each backlog holds, in hours only
acceptance: Agent and owner hours per backlog (coordinator included) from its totals line, else its records' Remaining cells, labelled as each project's own uncalibrated estimate
A solution total sums them; a backlog that cannot be read shows Unknown and the total reads `at least N h`; no percentage anywhere
Effort per component (counts by priority and size, its totals line); fixture with an unreadable total
privacy: Tool and procedure text only; fixtures are invented repositories and records; no personal data.
escalation: Any combined completion percentage is refused (the profile forbids it)

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24 at agent speed from the coordinator's proposal and its reference implementation. Not a measurement.
